findings.title: Four GO source locators incorrectly identify the input restriction as a direct subclass restriction
findings.description: proto-001, proto-006, proto-010 and proto-015 correctly assert GO input CHEBI:36241 and output CHEBI:15775, but their source_locator says rdfs:subClassOf restrictions for both. Direct original GO:0019618 subclass statements contain only output restriction _:riog00158934. Input _:riog00158930 is a member of owl:equivalentClass _:riog00158927 / owl:intersectionOf _:riog00158933; output _:riog00158929 is also in that intersection. This is an exact locator defect, not unsupported pathway identity.
findings.normalization_reason: Bounded provenance defect; original definition, xref and logical restriction still establish the correct biological scope.
